 burnd Launches the US's First Sunscreen Stick Made with BEMT, the Newly Approved European Filter
 News provided by
 burnd
 Nov 18, 2026, 08:44 ET
 Share this article
 Share this article
 burnd Stick SPF 38 broad spectrum 80-minute water resistant combines transparent zinc oxide with bemotrizinol, the first new sunscreen active approved in the U.S. since 1999 
 EAST HAMPTON, N.Y. , Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- burnd , the sun care brand co-founded by Dr. Mark Mitchnick, inventor of transparent zinc oxide, today launched burnd Stick   SPF 38 , the first sunscreen stick sold in the United States made with bemotrizinol (BEMT).  BEMT (bemotrizinol, sold as Parsol Shield®) is a broad-spectrum sunscreen filter used in Europe and elsewhere for more than 20 years. The stick combines zinc oxide with 3% BEMT and is water resistant for 80 minutes. 
 Continue Reading
 burnd Stick SPF 38 with BEMT 
 burnd Stick SPF 38 with BEMT 
 In June, the FDA added BEMT to the list of permitted sunscreen actives. It was the first addition since the 1999 final sunscreen monograph, which included zinc oxide, work Mitchnick was closely involved in. BEMT has been used in Europe and other markets for more than 20 years. The effort was led by DSM-Firmenich who, for their efforts, has an 18-month period where they exclusively supply BEMT to US companies. Carl D'Ruiz, Senior Manager, Business Development at DSM, stated, "BEMT's (PARSOL® Shield) outstanding performance gives formulators greater flexibility to create lighter, more consumer-friendly products without compromising protection. The enthusiasm we've seen since launch has been remarkable, and we are especially excited to see forward-thinking brands like burnd leveraging BEMT in innovative new ways."
 Zinc oxide and BEMT complement each other. Zinc oxide, a mineral, protects across UVB and well into long-wave UVA. BEMT dissolves into the formula and absorbs strongly across UVB and short-wave UVA. Both are stable in sunlight. Together they give powerful broad-spectrum coverage that neither delivers as well alone. 
 "When developing transparent zinc oxide, the point was protection people would actually wear," said Mitchnick. "BEMT is the first new tool American formulators have had in a generation. Getting this level of performance from just two filters was a challenge, but the result was worth the effort." The patent pending Stick is designed to deliver easy, mess-free application for sun protection on the move. Fragrance and preservative free, its base is made from light emollient oils and plant waxes, powerful antioxidants and a film former that keeps protection in place, even when sweating or in the water.
 Mitchnick co-founded burnd in 2025 with his son, CEO Malachy Mitchnick, to make the best sun and skin care products the science allows.
 "Sticks are a really convenient way to apply sunscreen. Whether it's the first application or a reapplication, they're great at the beach, on the course, at the kids' game or just walking around town. We wanted the newest protection in America in a format people can carry anywhere," said Malachy Mitchnick, co-founder and CEO of burnd.
 burnd Stick SPF 38 broad spectrum will be available November 10 th  at getburnd.com and Amazon for $29. Retail and wholesale inquiries: [email protected]  
 Images are available HERE .
 About burnd 
burnd is a science-driven sun and skin care brand based in East Hampton, New York, co-founded in 2025 by Dr. Mark Mitchnick, pediatrician and inventor of transparent zinc oxide (Z-Cote®), and CEO Malachy Mitchnick. The line includes burnd SPF 41, burnd Tinted SPF 34 with photolyase, burnd Cleanse and burnd Restore. Learn more at www.getburnd.com .
